entries.german: Klage des Pfarrverwesers Balthasar Rueprecht zu Aub beim Ritterstift gegen Konrad und Zeisolff v. Rosenberg wegen eines ihm (Pfarrer) strittig gemachten Handlohns zu Aub
entries.english: Complaint by the parish administrator Balthasar Rueprecht zu Aub to the collegiate chapter of canons against Konrad and Zaisolph von Rosenberg concerning a hand-money payment at Aub that had been disputed with him (the priest).
